owner_accepts_by_signing: Deploying the manager-only release named by manifest_sha256: the factory, the PackManager implementation and the three libraries. No PackVault.
The deployer becomes the factory admin and may change the implementation future managers clone (A9.8).

The operating return of a manager is not measured: no executed or modeled evidence shows a profitable reuse cycle. Launch accepts that.
